name: com.pulsereal/mcp
title: PulseReal
description: Rental-property analytics for US investors: cash flow, cap rate, DSCR, STR rules and listing search.

tools.name: calculate_deal
tools.description: Underwrites a rental purchase from its price and expected rent (or short-term rental revenue): cash flow (likely and conservative), cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, break-even and cash to close, using local property tax and insurance for the state. Deterministic; no listing needed. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

monthlyRent.description: Expected long-term monthly rent in USD.

strAnnualRevenue.description: Expected short-term rental gross revenue per year in USD.

downPaymentPct.description: Down payment as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

interestRate.description: Mortgage interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

tools.name: rank_markets
tools.description: Ranks US cities for rental investors by PulseReal Pulse Score, short-term rental cash-on-cash, occupancy or nightly rate, long-term gross rent yield, forecast 12-month appreciation, or affordability. Omit state for a national ranking. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

strategy.description: "ltr" for long-term rentals, "str" for short-term (Airbnb, Vrbo).

maxMedianPrice.description: Only markets with a median sale price at or below this, in USD.

tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description: Current median sale price and 12-month change, days on market, inventory, PulseReal forecast appreciation, average rent and gross yield, short-term rental Pulse Score, occupancy and nightly rate, and landlord-friendliness for one US city. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

tools.name: str_rules
tools.description: Short-term rental (Airbnb, Vrbo) licensing, tax, zoning and enforcement rules for a US city, with the share of local listings PulseReal classifies as STR-allowed. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

tools.name: explain_metric
tools.description: How PulseReal defines and calculates a metric (cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, Pulse Score, occupancy, ADR, rent, appreciation), its data sources and the conservative/optimistic range. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

metric.description: Metric name or question, e.g. "DSCR" or "how is rent estimated".

tools.name: underwrite_property
tools.description: Full underwriting of a specific for-sale US listing by address or PulseReal property id, using local rent and short-term rental data, with optional price, rent, down payment and rate overrides. Requires a PulseReal API key; full figures need a Pro plan. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

downPaymentPct.description: Down payment as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

interestRate.description: Mortgage interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

tools.name: find_deals
tools.description: Current for-sale listings in a US market that clear the given targets on PulseReal's conservative underwriting, ranked by fit then cash-on-cash. Requires a PulseReal API key. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

strategy.description: "ltr" for long-term rentals, "str" for short-term (Airbnb, Vrbo).

minCashOnCash.description: Minimum cash-on-cash return as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.
